wooden-barrel.label: Wooden Barrel
wooden-barrel.pivot: ground origin at the barrel's centre; base on z = 0
wooden-barrel.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
wooden-barrel.notes: Oak barrel with eight staves, three iron hoops, a dark base, a lid and a front bung. 0.45 m across, 0.5 m tall. The proposed footprint covers the whole barrel, so nothing overhangs it.

crate-stack.label: Crate Stack
crate-stack.pivot: ground origin at the centre of the base crate; base on z = 0
crate-stack.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
crate-stack.notes: Two closed timber crates with dark corner posts and plank seams. The 0.35 m top crate is offset one voxel to +X, leaving a ledge on the -X side. The footprint is the base crate; nothing overhangs it.

grain-sacks.notes: Three burlap sacks piled two and one, each gathered at the neck with a twine tie and a knot. 0.65 m wide, 0.5 m tall. The footprint covers the whole pile, so nothing overhangs it.

woodpile.label: Woodpile
